shortDescription: Hong Kong is benefiting from a record surge in offshore yuan debt issuance as competition for fixed-income business among financial centers intensifies, according to Bloomberg.The city has been Asia’s leading hub for bond underwriting for more than a decade.

title: Hong Kong Taps Record Offshore Yuan Bond Issuance as Debt Hub Rivalry Intensifies
